items.title: John Leguizamo, ator de 'A Odisseia', fará palestra na Mostra de SP
items.summary: O ator John Leguizamo será homenageado na Mostra Internacional de Cinema de São Paulo com o prêmio Leon Cakoff. O colombiano-americano vem ao Brasil para receber o troféu, que será dado nesta segunda-feira (26), às 20h. O evento acontece no Solar Fábio Prado, zona oeste da cidade. items.title: ‘Our third date was at Buckingham Palace’: Marlon James and Nicholas Boggs on life as a literary power couple
items.summary: Shortlisted for the Booker and Baillie Gifford prizes respectively, the novelist and biographer talk about working and living together – and giving a voice to Black queer historyThe literary power couple is a historically seductive concept. Two writers sharing a life, their private and creative worlds entwined, each becoming witness to and critic of the other’s work.
